entity: Critical Physical Exam (PE) Rule & Vaccine Exception
content: Critical Physical Exam (PE) Rule: If the patient's Physical Exam is PAST DUE, they are NOT ENTITLED to referrals, specialty appointments, shots/vaccines, digital imaging, or routine medication refills, and schools may block attendance. Always verify the last Wellness Visit (WCV) date and past-due flag in ECW. Vaccine Exception: Flu and RSV vaccines can be administered by the nurse on the nurse schedule regardless of whether the patient's PE is up to date.

Never calculate eligibility based on a general number of PEs per year; insurance coverage strictly follows milestone checkpoints: Birth to 6 weeks: Newborn Physical Exam (NB PE) at 3-5 days and 1 month. 6 weeks to 6 months: Every 2 months (2, 4, 6 months). 6 months to 2 years (24 months): Every 3 months (9, 12, 15, 18, 24 months). 2.5 years (30 months): As needed for Head Start program requirements. Age 3 through 21: Annually (once per year). Managed Care Early Exception: May repeat early if patient had a birthday, last PE was >= 6 months ago, and child has managed-care insurance.

Immunization Appointments: Parent or Adult Sibling (18+) REQUIRED with NO EXCEPTIONS; some vaccines require a mandatory 30-minute post-injection observation period. Sick / Acute Visits: Children 12 years and older may attend alone ONLY if parent gives verbal consent during the scheduling call (must document 'Consent- [Parent First Name]' in ECW comment box, and child must be able to communicate independently); children under 12 must be accompanied by a parent or adult sibling (18+). Infants & Babies: Strict prohibition—a 12-year-old sibling is NEVER permitted to bring an infant or baby; must be accompanied by a parent or adult sibling aged 18 or older.

entity: Same-Day Primary Provider Restriction & Acute Care Referral
content: Same-Day PCP Rule: A patient CANNOT see two primary care providers on the same day because insurance only reimburses one primary care visit per calendar day. If a patient seen earlier today calls wanting to be seen again by a different doctor: DO NOT book another pediatric primary care visit; instead transfer the call to a triage nurse to assess clinical urgency, OR schedule an appointment with Acute Care (which bills under urgent/acute care and is covered).

entity: Schedule Blocks, Arrival Times & Pre-Op Documentation
content: Removing Associated Blocks: When an appointment is moved or canceled, always delete the associated block (especially DNB blocks). Holding Appointment Slots: If placing a temporary block while assisting a caller or building a chart, you MUST add a note stating the reason along with your initials, or it will be deleted immediately. Stipulating Arrival Times: Always document the arrival time instructed to the patient in the ECW comment box. Pre-Op Reason Documentation: Include surgery date, surgery type, surgeon/hospital name, AND explicitly note 'Physical UTD' once verified. Walk-In Policy: Accepted for SICK VISITS ONLY; never accept walk-ins for physical exams, pre-ops, or specialty visits.

entity: New Patient Chart Verification & Phone Etiquette
content: Before creating a chart or adding a sibling to an existing family account: Confirm exact spelling of first/last name and full Date of Birth (DOB); verify current residential address and input at least two contact phone numbers; verify Responsible Party / Guarantor and active insurance; confirm primary local pharmacy. Phone Etiquette Standard: Answer within 3 rings with 'Thank you for calling Aizer Health, this is [Name], how can I help you?' and verify patient name and DOB before accessing ECW charts.

Newborn Physical (NB PE): Pre-bookable within first 6 weeks of birth; write 'NB PE, #Lab ID number, delivery hospital' in ECW. Physical Exam (PE / PE+SHOTS / PE+fever): Pre-bookable routine preventive exam following age frequencies. Same-Day Sick Visit (SAME DAY): NOT pre-bookable (Same-Day Only); write all symptoms in reason (e.g., FEVER + Cough); walk-ins accepted here only. Office Visit (OV): Pre-bookable follow-up by converting a same-day sick slot; used for Tongue Tie, WIC (reason HEMO), and Lactation. Pre-Operation Visit (PRE OP): Pre-bookable by converting same-day sick slot; document surgery type, date, surgeon, hospital, and Physical UTD. Hospital Follow-Up (PED HOS FU): Pre-bookable by converting same-day sick slot for hospital/ER discharge follow-up. Lactation Support (OV 30 min): Pre-bookable 30-min slot only with Dr. Chana Heintz, Dr. Tamar Dachoh, or Robin Aschkenasy. Tongue Tie Evaluation (OV or SAME DAY): Must be <= 5 weeks from delivery for in-house procedure; if > 5 weeks old, provider only evaluates and refers out.

Shots / Immunizations / Vaccines & Digital Imaging Requests: Route TE to PEDS Marisa Kraft (PE required; Flu/RSV on nurse schedule exempt). ENT & Nutritionist Referrals: Route TE to Hayley Newton (PE required). General Specialist Referrals: Route TE to Anisa Azeez (Referral Specialist; PE required). Controlled Substance Follow-Up & Weight Check Requests: Route TE to Sally Carilli (PE required; controlled substances booked in approved slots only). Medication Refill Requests: Route to PEDS Encounters queue (PE required; tag HIGH PRIORITY if completely out). Lab Results Inquiries: Route to PEDS Encounters queue (if Black Lock exists, do NOT discuss results). Medical Questions & Early Intervention (EI): Route to PEDS Encounters / PEDS Telephone Encounter queue. Specialty Care Transfers (Vision, Speech, PT, OT, Podiatry): NO TE required—warm transfer caller directly to the appropriate departmental queue.

entity: Clinical Forms, Stat Abnormal Labs & Pediatric Forms Drop-Off
content: Stat Abnormal Lab Results (e.g., LabCorp Bilirubin): DO NOT CREATE A TE—immediately call Sherri in the Lab at Ext. 1800. NYS Medication Authorization Form: Create TE and route to Nursing Team. WIC Form Request: Book OV with reason HEMO or send TE to Peds Telephone Encounter queue. Pediatric Forms Drop-Off: Verify chart/PE/immunizations before advising drop-off; parent must fill out parent sections first; 48-hour turnaround; nurse calls for pickup; walk form directly to designated bin on the west side of the nursing station (never leave unattended). Pediatric PE Forms Routing: Forward standard Pediatric PE forms to Alexa Puccini or Peds TE Inbox; EXCEPTION: Alexa does NOT handle Early Head Start forms (route to Peds TE Inbox / nursing workflow); NEVER send form requests directly to an individual nurse.

entity: Referral Request Workflow & Podiatry Referral Rule
content: Always check the patient's chart first before scheduling an appointment for a referral request. If referral was already discussed and documented by the doctor: follow provider's existing plan (no additional appointment needed). If never discussed and patient is due for a physical (or due for next age-based physical): schedule a physical. If up to date on physical and not due yet: schedule a regular Office Visit (OV). Podiatry Referral Rule: Do NOT automatically assume a podiatrist referral is needed when a parent requests one; the child's pediatrician must evaluate the foot concern first.

entity: Insurance Billing Policies, Non-Accepted Plans & $100 Self-Pay
content: MVP Commercial & CHP (Child Health Plus): NOT ACCEPTED as standalone coverage; accepted ONLY if patient has active Medicaid as secondary. Anthem Blue Cross (Prefix JLJ): NOT ACCEPTED for member IDs starting with 'JLJ' unless patient has active Medicaid as secondary. HealthFirst: Standalone commercial plans NOT ACCEPTED unless paired with active Medicaid or managed care. Self-Pay Flat Rate: Without eligible secondary coverage, provider visits are billed at a $100 flat rate (must be communicated upfront before booking); in-house testing is included in the $100 flat rate, while send-out labs / external testing are billed separately by the external lab.

entity: Controlled Substances Reference List & OTC Policy
content: Controlled Substances (Routed to Sally Carilli, scheduled in approved time slots only): Adderall, Amphetamine, Concerta, Methylphenidate, Guanfacine, Strattera, Intuniv, Ritalin, Vyvanse, Focalin, Xanax, Alprazolam. OTC / Analgesics Policy: Tylenol and Motrin are only dispensed in-clinic prior to checkout (covered by insurance); once checkout is complete, patients must purchase them over-the-counter (OTC).
